remarks: WELCOME TO UNIT 19 "THE GRAND" ARE YOU TIRED OF SEARCHING FOR YOUR NEXT GREAT RENTAL HOME??? WELL THIS IS IT!!! From the award winning Cottages at Richards Avenue comes the newest development on the Norwalk/Westport line "The Cottages at Pepperidge" offers this new, modern construction in a luxury, gated community of single family homes with complete first floor living. An age restricted, multigenerational community of 40 homes where at least one occupant must be 60 or over. This 3 Bdrm 4-1/2 Bath Grand Model Home with finished lower level features an open floor plan with gourmet kitchen expanding into dining room/living room. Enjoy sliders to private screened in porch with skylites and stairs down to a covered patio. Off the kitchen is the mudroom/laundry which leads to your private garage. There are 2 primary suites in this home. 1st floor primary suite w/ luxurious bath, heated floors, curb less shower & spacious walk-in closet. The 2nd floor master suite is complete with cathedral ceiling, ceiling fan, and bath with soaking tub, 2 separate vanities, and double closets. This floor also has an open, paneled loft/study and guest bedroom all with an abundance of closets and storage. Lower level bonus room for recreation, crafts, or gym, an additional full bath, and tons of storage. Maintenance free living w/ keyless entry and security. Located on the Westport Town line, This new community offers easy acces to all your familiar locations,
